name: openhands-agentos
description: Ouroboros AgentOS bridge for audited OpenHands CLI runs and handoffs.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect OpenHands CLI readiness without launching an agent.

arguments.name: openhands_bin
arguments.description: OpenHands CLI binary name or path.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run OpenHands headless JSON output inside an audited bounded workspace.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Bounded local workspace for the OpenHands run.

arguments.name: task_file
arguments.description: Workspace-relative task file passed to openhands --file.

commands.name: summarize
commands.summary: Summarize a captured OpenHands JSONL run.

commands.name: handoff
commands.summary: Convert a captured OpenHands JSONL run into an Ouroboros handoff artifact.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.description: Run metadata emitted by ooo openhands run.

commands.name: agentos
commands.summary: Run OpenHands and emit an AgentOS handoff in one bounded audited flow.

arguments.name: workspace
arguments.description: Bounded local workspace for the OpenHands run.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Goal passed to OpenHands and later summarized for Ouroboros.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record run metadata, OpenHands event counts, exit status, and handoff evidence.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record redacted command/environment provenance for OpenHands execution.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist JSONL, stderr, metadata, audit, and handoff artifacts under the bounded workspace.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Launch OpenHands CLI as an external runtime inside the plugin boundary.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Prepare machine-readable and Markdown handoff artifacts for Ouroboros workflows.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report blocked, failed, and completed states without losing evidence.

permissions.reason: Inspect workspace, task files, OpenHands CLI availability, and captured run artifacts.
Write JSONL captures, metadata, audit events, and handoff artifacts under .omx/.
Launch the OpenHands CLI with --headless --json after explicit trust acknowledgement.
